approval.notes: Negotiated harbour-to-forge transport exchange for the cart quest beat.

nodes.text: The harbour barrels will reach the forge if you hire a carter now. Six schillings buys a light run; ten buys a driver who will not wait for a second bargain.

choices.text: I will agree the carter's 6-10 schilling hire.
Wait. I will find another route.

nodes.text: The hire is agreed. Load the barrels and keep the forge route clear before curfew.
Then do not call it a civic charge when the watch closes the gate. The route simply waits for daylight.

source_notes.summary: The 6-10 schilling range and negotiated harbour-to-forge exchange are authored production dialogue based on the R-068/R-069 hook.
